 Deals and Sales Get up to 57% off at Target, Gap, Home Depot and more — these are the best early Black Friday sales happening now
 Save on popular picks from brands like Apple, Ninja, Clinique and more. Nov. 7, 2026, 7:00 AM EST Bethany Heitman
 Commerce Editor
 Most of the sales will run through Black Friday, but a few end within the next week. Ulta, Walmart, Target You don’t have to wait until Black Friday to start saving. Target , Walmart , Gap , Home Depot and Ulta have already launched early holiday sales, with up to 50% off tech, beauty, home items and more. Shopping now means you can grab popular items before they sell out and get a head start on your gift list. Below are the best early deals worth shopping. 
 The best early Black Friday deals at Target
 Ninja Air Fryer Pro XL 
 $ 99.99 $ 179.99 Target Now 44% off $ 99.99 $ 179.99 Amazon Now 44% off This Ninja air fryer does more than air fry. It has six cooking functions, including air fry, roast, bake, reheat, dehydrate and Max Crisp, which uses superheated airfor extra-crispy results. Its 6.5-quart nonstick basket holds up to 9 pounds of wings, and both the basket and crisper plate go in the dishwasher. 
 More early Black Friday deals at Target
 50% off Chefman 10-Cup Rice Cooker 
 50% off Keurig K-Mini Coffee Maker 
 40% off Crocs Adult Baya Lined Clogs 
 40% off Blooms by PlayDoh Wildflower Petite Bouquet 
 30% off Ninja PossibleCooker Pro 
 The best early Black Friday deals at Home Depot
 Ring Starter Set with Battery Doorbell 2K and Indoor Cam Plus 2K 
 $ 59.99 $ 139.99 Home Depot Now 57% off This Ring starter set aims to make home security easy. It pairs a doorbell camera with an indoor camera, so you get sharp, detailed video inside and out. A live view and two-way talk let you see, hear and speak to visitors, and the indoor cam has a lens cover for privacy. 
 More early Black Friday deals at Home Depot
 50% off Husky 310-Piece Mechanics Tool Set 
 40% off Milwaukee Lithium-Ion Cordless Ratchet HighTorque Impact Wrench 
 34% off Ryobi One+ 2-Tool Combo Kit 
 31% off Gorilla 22-Foot Aluminum Ladder 
 27% off Energizer 26-Pack AA Batteries 
 The best early Black Friday deals at Walmart
 Apple AirPods 4 
 $ 89.00 $ 129.99 Walmart Now 32% off Apple’s AirPods 4 have a shorter stem from previous models for a more comfortable fit. Voice isolation helps cut background noise on calls and you get up to 30 hours of total listening time with the compact USB-C charging case, plus an IP54 rating for sweat and water resistance.

 The best early Black Friday deals at Gap
 Gap Softest Flannel PJ Set 
 $ 59.00 $ 99.95 Gap Now 41% off Gap calls this their softest flannel ever, and the double-washed cotton is made for cozy nights in. The relaxed-fit set includes a button-front shirt with a notch collar and chest pocket, plus pants with an elastic drawcord waist and side pockets.
 More early Black Friday deals at Gap
 50% off Women’s Textured Dobby Fitted Shirt

 50% of Women’s Fitted Longline Denim Jacket

 The best early Black Friday deals at Ulta
 Clinique Clinique Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Rich Face Cream 
 $ 58.50 $ 78.00 Ulta Now 25% off $ 78.00 Sephora Clinique’s rich cream is made for drier skin that needs extra moisture. It combines a peptide complex the brand says helps boost collagen with hyaluronic acid and shea butter to hydrate and plump. It’s designed to visibly smooth lines and wrinkles, and it’s fragrance-free and oil-free.
